theme_strategy.rationale: High-end Revolut/Apple Wallet aesthetic demands a pure dark UI (#0A0A0A) rather than standard dark gray. High contrast pure whites and a striking cyan (#00C2FF) provide a premium 'Electric' punch while maintaining functional clarity.
theme_strategy.font_strategy: Outfit (Headings) + Inter (Body). Outfit offers a geometric, modern tech feel.

spacing_and_layout.app_container: max-w-md mx-auto w-full min-h-screen bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white relative overflow-x-hidden pb-24 shadow-2xl border-x border-white/5

bottom_nav.container: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/10 px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center z-50
bottom_nav.item: flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-[#A1A1AA] hover:text-white transition-colors
bottom_nav.center_action: h-14 w-14 rounded-full bg-[#00C2FF] text-black flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,194,255,0.4)] -translate-y-6

card.default: bg-[#141414] border border-white/5 rounded-3xl p-5 hover:bg-[#1a1a1a] transition-colors relative overflow-hidden
card.glass: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6

premium_credit_card.style: relative w-full aspect-[1.58/1] rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1A1A1A] to-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 p-6 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden shadow-2xl
premium_credit_card.glow_effect: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#00C2FF]/10 to-transparent opacity-50 pointer-events-none

structure: Header: User avatar, Greeting ('Good Evening, Alex'), Notification icon.
Hero: Glass panel with abstract background. Tagline: 'All-in-One App for Payments, Mobility & More'. Prominent total balance display.
Feature Grid (Bento): 'Wallet' (large span), 'Taxi' & 'Scooter' (medium span with background images), 'Food' & 'Auctions' (small spans). Use Lucide icons + subtle images.
Card Display: Premium black credit card visual with cyan glow edges. Shows card number ending and exp date.
Quick Actions: Add Money, Send, History. Circular buttons.
Transactions: List view. Date headers (e.g., 'Today'). Items have rounded icon backgrounds, merchant name, time, and right-aligned amount.
Camera Viewfinder: Dark background with a centered rounded-3xl frame.
Animation: Cyan laser line sweeping up and down inside the frame using Framer Motion.
Amount Input: Massive text (e.g., text-6xl+) in cyan or white.
Chart: Recharts simple AreaChart showing week earnings (Cyan stroke, cyan to transparent gradient fill).
Recent Payments: List of incoming transactions.

animations.scanner_laser: animate: { y: [0, 200, 0] }, transition: { repeat: Infinity, duration: 2, ease: 'linear' }

hero_abstract_bg.description: Dark abstract glowing cyan texture for hero cards

premium_card_bg.description: Subtle dark fluid background for premium credit card

scooter_image.description: Modern night scooter image for feature grid background

food_image.description: Premium dark restaurant food for feature grid background

iconography.instructions: Use strokeWidth={1.5} for all icons to maintain a delicate, premium aesthetic. Avoid chunky icons.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, tabs) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing their function (e.g., 'home-tab-btn', 'add-funds-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.aria_labels: Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons like the Scanner button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install framer-motion, lucide-react, recharts, and clsx/tailwind-merge if not already present.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for complex asymmetrical layouts like the Feature Bento Grid. Use custom divs instead of Shadcn standard Cards if they restrict the design.
Implement the 4 main pages and wire them with react-router-dom.
Force dark mode via Tailwind 'dark' class or strictly use the dark color palette (#0A0A0A base).
Ensure the mobile-first layout is constrained within a 'max-w-md mx-auto' container so it looks like a mobile app even on desktop browsers.
Populate the app with realistic mock data (e.g., 'Uber Trip', 'Apple Store', 'Merchant Dashboard Earnings').
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs. Use ONLY the provided URLs in the media section.
Ensure the bottom navigation stays fixed and layered above all content (z-50).
